## The book

::: {.book-card}
::: {.book-cover}
<span class="book-cover-title">O Manual do Cientista de Dados</span>
<span class="book-cover-author">Wlademir Prates</span>
:::
::: {.book-body}
### O Manual do Cientista de Dados

A free, open handbook in Portuguese about data science in practice: statistics, modeling, visualization and the reasoning behind them. An ongoing project, written in Quarto and open to contributions.

[Read online](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}
:::
